info.name: RAKEZ ERP - Simple Commission MVP
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Simple Commission MVP (5 stages).

Stages covered:
  Stage 1 — Sales Reservation Participants
  Stage 2 — Project Commission Settings
  Stage 3 — Commission Preview
  Stage 4 — Commission Generation
  Legacy — Manual commission endpoint (still active)

All routes are on branch `yusuf`. Auth: Bearer token via Sanctum.
Permissions: sales.reservations.view|create (Sales), accounting.sold-units.view|manage (Accounting).

Formulas:
  buyer  → commission = unit_price × rate / 100
  owner  → commission = unit_price / (1 + rate / 100)

UnitPriceResolver priority:
  1. commission.final_selling_price
  2. reservation.proposed_price
  3. contractUnit.price
  4. throws UnitPriceUnresolvedException (422)

variable.description: contracts.id — project_id in project_commission_settings refers to contracts.id

item.name: Stage 1 — Sales Reservation Participants
item.description:
Endpoints for managing participants on a sales reservation.

Middleware: auth:sanctum, role:sales|sales_leader|admin
Permission: sales.reservations.view (GET), sales.reservations.create (POST)

Note: PUT /participants has no explicit route-level permission middleware — authorization is enforced inside SyncReservationParticipantsRequest via policy.

request.description:
Returns all users with type=sales, sorted by name, including the authenticated user.
Registered BEFORE the {reservation}/participants route to prevent wildcard capture.

Permission: sales.reservations.view
Expected: 200 OK with data[] of {id, name, email, type, team: {id, name}|null}

request.description:
Creates a new sales reservation with optional participants[].

Permission: sales.reservations.create

Key defaults (prepareForValidation):
  contract_date → today if omitted
  client_nationality → 'غير محدد' if omitted
  client_iban → '-' if omitted
  payment_method → 'cash' if omitted
  down_payment_status → 'refundable' if omitted
  purchase_mechanism → 'cash' if omitted

For negotiation type, also send:
  negotiation_notes, negotiation_reason, proposed_price (must be < unit price)

Conditional:
  evacuation_date required if is_off_plan AND down_payment_status = non_refundable

Expected: 201 Created

Full sync (replace) of participants for a reservation.
Authorization: SyncReservationParticipantsRequest policy (no explicit route middleware).
Sends participants = [] to clear all participants.
Duplicate user_id entries are rejected (distinct validation).

Expected: 200 OK with updated data[]

item.name: Stage 2 — Project Commission Settings
item.description:
CRUD + activate endpoints for project commission settings.

Middleware: auth:sanctum, role:accounting|admin
Permission: accounting.sold-units.view (GET), accounting.sold-units.manage (POST/PUT/activate)

Key rules:
  - project_id is contracts.id
  - commission_source: buyer | owner
  - All percentages 0–100, nullable
  - Management user + percentage > 0 must be provided together
  - Total of (all bucket percentages) + (all management percentages) ≤ 100
  - Only one active setting per project (activate deactivates all others)

query.description: Items per page. Optional, default varies.

request.description:
Creates a buyer-source commission setting.

Formula: commission = unit_price × commission_percentage / 100
Formula key: buyer_unit_price_times_rate

Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage

Bucket totals in this example:
  assigned buckets: 10+10+10 = 30%
  outside buckets: 5+5+5 = 15%
  management: 15+10+10+5 = 40%
  Total: 85% ≤ 100% ✅

Expected: 201 Created

Creates an owner-source commission setting.

Formula: commission = unit_price / (1 + commission_percentage / 100)
Formula key: owner_unit_price_divided_by_100_percent_plus_rate

WARNING: The formula result IS the commission amount directly.
Do NOT subtract it from unit_price.

Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage

Bucket totals in this example:
  assigned buckets: 15+10+10 = 35%
  outside buckets: 8+7+5 = 20%
  management: 20+10+5 = 35%
  Total: 90% ≤ 100% ✅

Expected: 201 Created

Returns a single project commission setting with loaded relations:
  project, creator, ceoUser, salesManagerUser, salesLeaderUser, groupLeaderUser, externalMarketerUser

Permission: accounting.sold-units.view OR accounting.sold-units.manage
Expected: 200 OK

Updates an existing project commission setting.
Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage

Total check: 12+12+12 + 6+6+6 + 15+10+5 = 84% ≤ 100% ✅

Expected: 200 OK

Activates a project commission setting.
Sets is_active = true for this setting and deactivates all others for the same project.

Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage
Body: none required
Expected: 200 OK with {success, message, data:{...is_active:true}}

item.name: Stage 3 — Preview
item.description:
Read-only commission calculation previews. No DB writes.

Middleware: auth:sanctum, role:accounting|admin
Permission: accounting.sold-units.view OR accounting.sold-units.manage (handled in Form Request)

Preview always requires an active project commission setting for the project.

request.description:
Calculates commission preview for a project based on a given base_amount.

Route: POST /api/accounting/projects/{project}/preview-commission
Controller: ProjectCommissionPreviewController::previewProject()

IMPORTANT: Although base_amount is nullable in validation rules, the underlying service
throws 422 if base_amount is missing or ≤ 0. Always send it.

Requires: active ProjectCommissionSetting for this project.
Expected: 200 OK with {success, data: {source, formula_key, commission_percentage, commission_amount, ...}}

Calculates full unit commission preview for a reservation including per-participant distributions.

Route: POST /api/accounting/reservations/{reservation}/preview-unit-commission
Controller: ProjectCommissionPreviewController::previewUnit()

Override price (optional):
  If override_unit_price > 0 is sent, it overrides UnitPriceResolver.
  This override is NOT saved to DB — preview only.

UnitPriceResolver priority (when no override):
  1. commission.final_selling_price
  2. reservation.proposed_price
  3. contractUnit.price
  4. throws UnitPriceUnresolvedException (422)

Omit override_unit_price or send {} to use UnitPriceResolver.

Expected: 200 OK with full distribution breakdown:
  {reservation_id, project_id, unit_price, commission_source, commission_percentage,
   formula_key, unit_commission_amount, distributions[], unresolved[], total_distributed, remaining_amount}

item.name: Stage 4 — Generate Unit Commission
item.description:
Persists the unit commission and distributions to the database.

Middleware: auth:sanctum, role:accounting|admin
Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage

Safeguards:
  - Rejects if commission exists with calculated_by_project_setting = false (manual/legacy)
  - Rejects if commission is not pending
  - Rejects if any distribution is not pending
  - On regeneration: only deletes pending distributions (approved/paid are safe)
  - Wrapped in DB::transaction()
  - Post-persist: validates sum(distributions) ≤ unit_commission_amount + 0.02

request.description:
Generates (or regenerates) the unit commission for a reservation.

Route: POST /api/accounting/reservations/{reservation}/generate-unit-commission
Controller: UnitCommissionGenerationController::generate()

No request body required. The reservation ID from the route is enough.

Internal flow:
  1. preview() — calculates distributions (no write)
  2. assertPreviewSafeForPersist() — validates amounts
  3. assertReservationAllowsGeneration() — blocks manual/legacy commissions
  4. DB::transaction { upsert Commission + create CommissionDistributions }
  5. Post-persist sum check
  6. Returns generated commission + distributions + unresolved + totals

Response shape:
  {success, message, data: {
    commission: {id, reservation_id, contract_unit_id, final_selling_price,
                 commission_source, commission_percentage, total_amount, net_amount,
                 calculation_formula_key, calculated_by_project_setting,
                 project_commission_setting_id},
    distributions: [{user_id, percentage, amount, source_scope, source_type}],
    unresolved: [{source_scope, source_type, percentage, amount, reason}],
    total_distributed: float,
    remaining_amount: float
  }}

Expected: 200 OK on success

item.name: Legacy Compatibility
item.description:
The original manual commission endpoint. Still fully active.

Middleware: auth:sanctum, role:accounting|admin
Permission: accounting.sold-units.manage

Legacy commissions have calculated_by_project_setting = false (default).
They CANNOT be replaced by the generate endpoint — this is an intentional safeguard.

request.description:
Creates a manual commission for a reservation (legacy endpoint).

Route: POST /api/accounting/sold-units/{id}/commission
Controller: AccountingCommissionController::createManual()

The {id} here is the sales_reservation_id.

Resulting commission will have calculated_by_project_setting = false,
which means the Stage 4 generate endpoint will REFUSE to overwrite it (422).

Required fields:
  contract_unit_id, final_selling_price, commission_percentage, commission_source

Optional fields:
  team_responsible, marketing_expenses, bank_fees

Expected: 201 Created

item.name: Error & QA Cases
[422] Preview — No Active Setting for Project

request.description:
Uses a non-existent or project with no active commission setting.
Expected: 404 (project not found) or 422 with errors.project_commission_setting.

Error message: 'No active project commission setting for this project.'
Error key: project_commission_setting

To trigger this error:
  1. First create a manual commission via POST /api/accounting/sold-units/{id}/commission
  2. Then attempt to generate via this endpoint

Expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity
Error key: commission
Error message: 'This reservation has a legacy or manual commission. Project-based generation cannot replace it.'

This is the assertReservationAllowsGeneration() safeguard in UnitCommissionGenerationService.

To trigger this error:
  1. Generate a commission (calculated_by_project_setting = true)
  2. Move the commission status to 'approved' or 'paid' (via other endpoints)
  3. Then attempt to regenerate via this endpoint

Expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity
Error key: commission
Error message: 'Commission is not editable in its current status.'

Also triggered if any distribution has status != 'pending':
  'Cannot regenerate: non-pending distributions exist.'

Safeguard: protects approved/paid commissions from accidental overwrites.
